title: Sable and the Vector
author: Vesper Okafor
blurb: Silas Lockridge, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
